ConnectionStrings._comment_PrivilegedConnection: RLS increment 2b/3. BLANK (the committed default) = NON-BREAKING: the ConnectionRoutingInterceptor always uses DefaultConnection and Hangfire storage stays on DefaultConnection, so behaviour is identical to today. The increment-3 FLIP is to (1) run Persistence/Rls/roles.sql on the target DB to create hrm_app (NOBYPASSRLS) + hrm_owner (BYPASSRLS), (2) point DefaultConnection at hrm_app and set PrivilegedConnection to the hrm_owner conn string, and (3) set Rls:Enabled=true. Then the interceptor routes resolved-non-system tenant requests to hrm_app (RLS enforced) and startup/system/unresolved/job paths + Hangfire schema DDL to hrm_owner. DEV ENFORCEMENT (decision): appsettings.Development.json will later repoint DefaultConnection->hrm_app + PrivilegedConnection->hrm_owner after roles.sql is run on hris_dev_db (the default 'developer' role is a superuser and superusers always bypass RLS, so dev proves nothing until repointed). Do NOT set these now.

Encryption._comment: P3-4 field-at-rest encryption (AES-256-GCM) for sensitive PIP notes + Recommendation compensation. ActiveKeyId selects the key for new writes; Keys:{keyId} = base64-encoded 32-byte AES-256 key. BLANK Keys here (the committed default) => the app FAIL-FASTS at startup rather than store plaintext. Supply the real key via env/secret store in prod: Encryption__Keys__hrm-field-key-1=<base64 32 bytes> (generate: openssl rand -base64 32). Dev uses the committed dev-only key in appsettings.Development.json. Retired keys stay in Keys so old values still decrypt during rotation.

VirusScanning._comment: ISSUE-101 upload malware scanning. DEPLOY-GATE (mirrors Encryption above): the ClamAv scanner is enabled ONLY when ClamAv:Host is non-blank; BLANK here (the committed default) => the app uses the AllowWithLog stub, so local dev + the xUnit gate + CI (which run no clamd) stay green. To enable fail-closed scanning in prod/staging, run a clamd (daemon on the app server, or the official clamav/clamav container ~1.5-2GB RAM) and set the host via env/secret BEFORE app start: VirusScanning__ClamAv__Host=<clamd-host> (optionally VirusScanning__ClamAv__Port=3310). FailOpen stays false = fail-closed: a down/unreachable daemon returns Infected('scan-unavailable') so uploads are REJECTED (400), never stored unscanned. Set FailOpen=true ONLY to intentionally allow-with-log when the scanner is unavailable. clamd is free/open-source (GPLv2); invoked over a TCP socket (no GPL code linked into this app).

Entra._comment: CR-AUTH-001 Enterprise SSO (Microsoft Entra/O365). Enabled=false OR blank ClientId/ClientSecret/RedirectUri → SSO is OFF (login button reports 'not configured'). Put ClientSecret in user-secrets, NOT here: dotnet user-secrets set "Authentication:Entra:ClientSecret" "<secret>". TenantAllowList (the US-AUTH-013 isolation guard) is dev-only config and lives in appsettings.Development.json.

Recruitment._comment: DF-7 (US-REC-008 NFR-6, ISSUE-130) applicant-portal magic-link per-IP anti-abuse throttle. PortalLink caps how many portal tokens ONE client IP may mint (across all applicant emails) within IpWindowSeconds; the same limits drive BOTH the distributed Redis fixed-window counter (used when ConnectionStrings:Redis is set) and the DB sliding-window fallback (no Redis). Defaults reproduce the historical hardcoded 10-per-hour cap. The HMAC signing secret (Recruitment:PortalTokenSecret) is NOT here — it lives in user-secrets, falling back to Jwt:PrivateKey.

Smtp._comment: US-NTF-006 real email delivery. Non-secret here; Smtp:Username + Smtp:Password live in user-secrets (never commit credentials). BLANK Host => log-only stub (LogOnlyEmailSender), the safe default that sends nothing. Set Host (via user-secrets/appsettings.Development.json) to enable the MailKit SmtpEmailSender — e.g. Gmail Host=smtp.gmail.com Port=587 (app password required), or smtp4dev Host=localhost Port=2525 UseStartTls=false. FromAddress defaults to Username when omitted.

SecondLevelCache._comment: P3 EF second-level (query-result) cache (EFCoreSecondLevelCacheInterceptor). Transparent caching of SELECTs whose tables are ALL in CachedTables, with auto-invalidation on SaveChanges. Redis-backed when ConnectionStrings:Redis is set, in-memory otherwise (never a hard dependency; a Redis outage degrades to a DB read). Cache keys are tenant-prefixed (t:{tenantId}: / sys: / none:) so results never cross tenants. CachedTables MUST be slow-changing, read-heavy REFERENCE tables only — NEVER role/permission tables (owned by the permission cache) or volatile/transactional tables (attendance, leave requests, payroll runs, notifications, audit). TtlMinutes: absolute expiry for reference data (~30-60 min). Remove a table here to stop caching it; leave CachedTables empty to fall back to the built-in default whitelist.

OpenTelemetry._comment: P3 observability (docs/Architecture/observability-otel-grafana-plan.md). OtlpEndpoint is the OTLP/gRPC address of the OTel Collector (e.g. http://localhost:4317 or http://otel-collector:4317 in compose). BLANK (the default) => Console exporter only, NO external dependency: the app starts and runs normally with no collector. Also honoured via the standard OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT env var. Set OtlpEndpoint (via appsettings.Development.json / env) to ship traces+metrics to the Collector.

GlitchTip._comment: US-PLT-006 error tracking via SELF-HOSTED GlitchTip (Sentry-API-compatible; ADR-2026-07-08 Decision 1). Dsn is BLANK here on purpose (the shipped default) and MUST stay blank in this committed file — the DSN is a SECRET supplied ONLY via user-secrets/env (Critical Rule #6): dotnet user-secrets set "GlitchTip:Dsn" "<project-dsn>" (or env GlitchTip__Dsn=...). BLANK Dsn => the Sentry SDK is INERT (no init, no network calls, no behaviour change) — safe-by-default (AC-3). Set the DSN to the project DSN issued by your GlitchTip instance (ops/glitchtip/docker-compose.yml, :8000) to start capturing exceptions. When set: exceptions are captured with stack + release, tagged tenant_id/tenant_subdomain, and PII (request body, Authorization, cookies, query, email, national id) is scrubbed in BeforeSend before anything leaves the process; SendDefaultPii is forced false. Additive to the Serilog console/file sinks and the OTel wiring — replaces neither.
